originalDsl:
@diagram architecture
layout [direction: DOWN]
User service as "New User"
SignupForm service as "Signup Form"
AuthService service as "Auth Service"
UserDB database as "User Database"
EmailService service as "Email Verification Service"
ProfileWizard service as "Profile Setup Wizard"
WelcomeService service as "Welcome Email Service"
Dashboard service as "User Dashboard"
AnalyticsService service as "Analytics Service"

edge_1 = User -> SignupForm as "submits signup form"
edge_2 = SignupForm -> AuthService as "create account"
edge_3 = AuthService -> UserDB as "store credentials"
edge_4 = AuthService -> EmailService as "send verification email"
edge_5 = EmailService -> User as "deliver verification link"
edge_6 = User -> AuthService as "clicks verification link"
edge_7 = AuthService -> ProfileWizard as "redirect to"
edge_8 = ProfileWizard -> UserDB as "save profile data"
edge_9 = ProfileWizard -> WelcomeService as "trigger"
edge_10 = WelcomeService -> Dashboard as "redirect to"
edge_11 = Dashboard -> AnalyticsService as "log activity"

injectedDefects.description: removed closing quote on label "Welcome Email Service"
